GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (19 Feb 46) LS-L
(SCAPIN-1941)
APO 500
9 November 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government 19 February 1946, subject: Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction, SCAPIN 756, as amended.
2. Delete paragraph 4 of said memorandum, as amended by SCAPIN 853, 25 March 1946, and substitute therefor the following:
The Commanding General of the Eighth Army and the Commander, Naval Forces, Far East, have been directed to appoint Military Occupation Courts, including Military Commissions and Provost Courts, with jurisdiction over the foregoing persons and offenses. The Commanding General, Headquarters and Service Group, General Headquarters, Far East Command, has been directed to appoint Provost Courts for the Metropolitan Tokyo Area, with similar jurisdiction.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
